heading: TRIO TWIST  GREEN TEA
description: The twist duo green tea is a treat for your four-legged friend. It is a braid of clear rawhide, a tasty strip with green tea flavour and rawhide
bodyDescription: The VOSKES Trio Green Tea is a plait made from white cowhide, a tasty green tea-flavoured strip and rawhide. A chewy and delicious snack. Its shape also helps to keep teeth clean.
